profile.headline: Rest API | Full Stack | C# .Net Core | Azure | Microservices | Mulesoft | Angular | React | SQL
profile.summary:
Self - motivated Solution Architect / Sr. Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience in system design,
development, analysis and implementation using Microsoft Technologies for enterprise applications with
Azure/AWS/Salesforce cloud.

Enterprise-level experience - Working with large teams and involved in architecture of highly scalable, secure,
distributed applications, aligned with company standards, process, methodologies, and best practices.

Have good exposure to various domains like Financial, Consumer Small Business, Private Wealth Management,
Investment Banking, Insurance, Employee Benefits, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Toll Management System,
Intelligent Transportation System, Smart City solutions, Education, and Non-profit.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Active contributor from the product inception responsible for creating the technical vision and definition of
technical stack based on functional / nonfunctional requirements. Collaborated with team on
implementing new features in an agile environment.
 Implemented Microservices based Cloud Architecture on Azure. Designed and developed restful
microservices using Azure Functions using C#.NET and deployed it using Azure API Management.
 Designed and developed docker based applications using C#/.NET Core.
 Worked with Angular 9-15 to create web components and implemented test cases. Developed custom
modular components and services using RxJS, NgRx, Angular Material, Typescript to implement key
functionalities.
 Worked as a team leader and technical support doing code reviews.

Environment:
ASP .NET, C#, MVC, Web APIs, HTML5, JavaScript, Angular 9-15, SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, DevOps, GIT, Bitbucket,
Jira.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer (Lead)
positions.description:
Completed Salesforce integration project, architecting & developing Mulesoft APIs for near real time sync, DB2/Informatica Development for data migration. 
Developed complex mappings & mapplets in Informatica to load the data using different transformations. 
Architected, designed & implemented MuleSoft APIs for near real time sync. 
Designed and developed applications using C#/.NET Core. 
Designed Outlook Plugin which syncs in real time with ASP.NET web application.
Developed SQL Queries and Stored Procedures for accessing data from the SQL Server database & DB2. 
Involved in requirement analysis, design and development.
Designed reports in Cognos & created dashboards in Tableau.
Logging, Capturing, analyzing and resolving defects. 
Dev, Production Support and Deployment.

Environment: ASP .NET, C#, MVC, Web APIs, WCF Services, SOAP, REST, HTML5, JavaScript, Angular 5-6, 5QL Server, SSIS, AutoSys, DevOps, GIT, Bitbucket, Jira, Mulesoft, Salesforce, Informatica.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description:
Developed dashboards to visually tracks, analyzes, and displays key performance indicators (KPI), metrics
and key data points to monitor the health of the application.
Created a web-based reporting system using Angluar, HTML5, CSS, C#, MVC, .Net WebAPIs, REST, WCF
Services, SQL Server, and Oracle.
Designed custom SQL queries and stored procedures to create tables, views, perform data analysis and data
manipulation

Environment:
ASP.Net MVC 4, C#.Net, .Net WebAPIs, Entity Framework, Angular, Visual Studio 2012, SQL Server 2008, Oracle

positions.title: Software Development Project Manager
positions.description:
Worked on numerous projects from small business solutions to enterprise solutions. Approached business
challenges with creative thinking providing innovative solutions with low development cost and fast
development time.

Analyzed complex system problems and worked across internal teams and external teams to identify
problem sources and agree on solutions.
Designed and developed website using ASP.NET MVC, C#.NET, HTML 5, CSS 3, Bootstrap, JavaScript,
JQuery, KnockoutJS, Web API.
Involved in Interface’s Design and Data modeling design.
Used Entity Framework to implement the data access layer to communicate with databases.
Implemented LINQ for querying using different joins, sorting, filtering the complex objects.
Strong abilities in managing Index, writing stored procedures, Views, PIVOT, functions etc. in MS SQL
Server and involved in all the stages of System Development Life Cycle.
Designing Reports using Telerik Reporting.
Logging, Capturing, analyzing and resolving defects.
Dev, Production Support and Deployment.

Environment:
ASP.Net MVC 5, C#.Net, HTML 5, CSS 3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, JQuery, KnockoutJS, Entity Framework 6,
Web API, Telerik Reporting, jqGrid, SQL - Server 2012, .Net Framework 4.5, Visual Studio 2015.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked in an Agile team of .NET developers for a fast-paced software development firm.

 Developed and provided maintenance for 20+ .NET websites, using ASP.NET MVC, jQuery, HTML, CSS,
JavasScript, SQL Server, MySQL. Achieved 100% client satisfaction and on-time completion.
 Created real-world eCommerce websites for various clients. One said, “You’ve increased my revenue by
50% overnight.”
 Worked on business requirements and developed solution using Agile Methodology.
 Designed and developed website using ASP.NET MVC, C#.NET, Java Script, JQuery, WCF.
 Implemented client-side validations using JQuery.
 Implementing new changes and updates required for the platform.
 Using List and LINQ extensively in implementation of the project.
 Involved in integration testing of the Application in Development environment and written test methods
using unit test.
 Production & UAT Support
 Deployment

Environment:
ASP.Net MVC 4, C#.Net, EF, LINQ/ Entity, AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, .Net Framework 4.5, Visual Studio
2008-2010

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
Developed multiple enterprise internal systems for Technical Training Institute.
 Worked on business requirements and developed solution using Agile Methodology
 Adopted 3-tier architecture for the system design, which includes presentation layer, data access layer and
Business layer.
 Entity Framework was used to implement the data access layer to communicate with databases.
 Designed and developed .Net web components and user controls using ASP.NET and C#.NET.
 Worked in ASP.NET security mechanism such as Impersonation, Authentication and Authorization and
different state maintenance mechanism like Session, View State etc.
 Developed ASP.NET Master Pages and handled events between master pages and content pages.
 Designed and developed an interactive Content Management System (CMS) with a back-end in ASP.Net
(C#) with an MS-SQL database server, utilizing a browser driven component for content editing, with inline
previewing.
 Developed SQL Queries and Stored Procedures for accessing data from the SQL Server database.

Environment:
ASP.NET, C#.Net, Entity Framework, T-SQL, Visual Studio 2010, SQL Server 2008, .NET Framework 4.5
